eligibility.quote: Any plans to support zero-copy IPC in [CameraPublisher](https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/blob/ros2/image_transport/include/image_transport/camera_publisher.hpp)? I think this means adding publish methods in Publisher and CameraPublisher that take unique_ptrs. I'd be willing to look into this if there is interest.

loudness.quote: Working with a [high-speed camera](https://github.com/fhwedel-hoe/pylon_instant_camera) and a relatively weak system, the copying eats quite a lot of CPU as discussed [here](https://answers.ros.org/question/312964/ros2-megapixel-image-pubsub-cpu-usage-is-very-high/).

resolution.quote: This PR is my attempt to add support for publishing using `std::unique_ptr` without breaking any of the existing APIs.
